sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B on Tesla V100s: rewritten sm70 attention kernels + N-GPU tensor parallel for NInfer, built on the ninfer-v100 port. Two GPUs today (x is reserved for more), ~100 tok/s at 186K context on 2× V100 32G over plain PCIe, no NVLink. Full API contract of the single-GPU build (OpenAI / Anthropic-compatible HTTP, MTP, INT8 KV, prefix cache, vision). 中文说明在下面。
